findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 22 December 2025.

One corporate person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, holding ownership of shares of 75 to 100 percent.
The company has 2 current officers: one director, PERSON 268, appointed 11 May 2022, and one other officer.
The current director, PERSON 268, has 11 other appointments recorded, of which 8 are active, 2 dissolved and 1 in liquidation, and the registry notes this list may be incomplete.
No charges are registered against the company, and no registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations were filed since 24 October 2025.
